title: Shop — Logs
description: Application logs of the shop services from VictoriaLogs: volume and error trends, message patterns, what failing lines have in common, pods and versions, one request across services, the explorer and the log pipeline.

list.name: request
list.label: Request (latest first)

query.query: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` level:in($level) trace_id:* | sort by (_time desc) | limit 30 | format "<_time>" as t | replace ("T", " ") at t | replace_regexp ("\\.[0-9]+Z$", " UTC") at t | format "<t> · <service> · <_msg> · <trace_id>" as option

list.definition: option: latest lines with a trace ID

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, job, deployment, slo) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Shop.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

panels.title: Log lines
panels.description: Lines the selected services logged in the time range (all levels).

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: WARN lines. Here mostly business outcomes (unknown user, declined payment), see Patterns.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: ERROR lines: a request failed for a technical reason.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of ERROR lines among all lines of the selected services.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats count() if (level:=ERROR) errors, count() lines | math errors*100/lines as error_ratio | delete errors, lines

panels.title: Services logging errors
panels.description: Services with at least one ERROR line. More than one at the same time usually means a shared dependency (database, Redis, a called service).

panels.title: Lines outside the JSON logger
panels.description: Lines without a level: library loggers that bypass slog (go-redis logs Sentinel discovery and master changes), Go panics and crash output. Listed under Log explorer.

panels.title: Error ratio by service
panels.description: Share of ERROR lines per service. A service that logs more lines (more traffic) does not look worse here; compare with the Errors per service timeline below.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats by (service) count() if (level:=ERROR) errors, count() lines | math round(errors*100/lines, 0.01) as error_ratio | delete errors, lines

panels.title: Errors per service
panels.description: ERROR lines per service and interval: when each service started and stopped failing, and which failed first. Rollouts and critical alerts are marked on the graphs above.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats by (service) count() if (level:=ERROR) errors

panels.title: Message patterns
panels.description: What the selected lines say, grouped by pattern, with the cause (err) the service logged. Click a message to list only its lines, a sample request to see that request across services or its trace.

value.title: Show only lines with this message
Show the logs of this request (Request row)
Open the trace in Shop — Traces

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` level:in($level) | collapse_nums prettify | collapse_nums at err prettify | extract_regexp "^(?P<search_key>[^<]*)" from _msg | stats by (service, level, _msg, err) count() lines, count_uniq(kubernetes.pod_name) pods, min(_time) first, max(_time) last, max(trace_id) request, max(search_key) search_key | total_stats sum(lines) total | math round(lines*100/total, 0.01) as share, round(first/1e6) as first_ms, round(last/1e6) as last_ms | delete total, first, last | sort by (lines desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Patterns over time
panels.description: The same patterns per interval: a new pattern appearing, or one jumping, marks the start of a problem.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` level:in($level) | collapse_nums prettify | stats by (service, _msg) count() lines

panels.title: What these lines have in common
panels.description: Most frequent values of each field in the selected lines and the share of lines carrying them. One product, user, pod, node or version near 100% points at the cause.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` level:in($level) | delete _msg, err, _time, _stream, _stream_id, trace_id, span_id, output_stream, kubernetes.container_id, kubernetes.container_name, kubernetes.pod_ip, kubernetes.pod_namespace, kubernetes.pod_labels.pod-template-hash, kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/name, kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/part-of, kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/component, kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, kubernetes.pod_labels.topology.kubernetes.io/region | facets 5 keep_const_fields | replace_regexp ("^kubernetes\\.(pod_labels\\.)?([a-z]+\\.kubernetes\\.io/)?", "") at field_name | stats by (field_name, field_value) sum(hits) lines | format if (field_name:=level) "<lines>" as level_lines | total_stats sum(level_lines) total | math round(lines*100/total, 0.1) as share | delete level_lines, total | filter -field_name:=level | sort by (share desc) | limit 60

panels.title: Lines by pod
panels.description: One pod, node or version with more errors than its peers points at the pod, the node or a rollout rather than the code path. Click a pod to list its lines in the explorer.

value.title: Show this pod's lines in the explorer

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | copy "kubernetes.pod_labels.topology.kubernetes.io/zone" as zone | copy "kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/version" as version | stats by (kubernetes.pod_name, kubernetes.pod_node_name, zone, version) count() lines, count() if (level:=WARN) warnings, count() if (level:=ERROR) errors | math round(errors*100/lines, 0.01) as error_ratio | sort by (errors desc, warnings desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Warnings and errors by version
panels.description: Lines per image version (app.kubernetes.io/version). A new version bringing new errors shows here at the rollout (blue annotation).

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` level:in(ERROR, WARN) | copy "kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/version" as version | stats by (version, level) count() lines

panels.title: All lines of one request, oldest first
panels.description: Every service's lines with the trace ID picked in the Request variable (latest $level lines first) or clicked in Message patterns. The panel link opens the trace.

links.title: Open the trace in Shop — Traces

panels.title: Lines — $level
panels.description: Expand a line for its fields; trace_id links to the trace. Narrow with Message contains and Filters (any field).

panels.title: Lines outside the JSON logger
panels.description: Output without a level: library loggers (go-redis Sentinel), Go panics and crash output.

panels.title: Log pipeline — is every line arriving?
Last line per service
panels.description: A service that stops logging while it serves traffic has lost its log shipping (or hangs).

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) | stats by (service) max(_time) last, count() lines | math round(last/1e6) as last_ms | delete last

panels.title: Log bytes by service
panels.description: Uncompressed size of all fields per interval: who drives log volume (storage and cost).

panels.title: Lines dropped or skipped
panels.description: Lines per second VictoriaLogs or the collector did not store (whole cluster). Should stay at 0.

panels.title: Collector backlog
panels.description: Data vlagent has collected but not yet delivered (left) and failed or retried sends per second (right). A growing backlog delays every log panel.
